decisions.reason: Standalone paragraph needs a subject; fronting the ten minutes matches 10분 만에 better than a fragment starting with And.
재수 옴 붙었네 is a jinx/bad-luck idiom, not a curse; cursed overstates it and breaks the later day callback.
많이 쳐 줘야 20대 중후반 is mid-to-late twenties even being generous; SOL drops mid and changes it to an age cap.
이상하다. 좀 많이. is one two-sentence beat; splitting it off here would orphan Very off unless the insert also lands.
No source paragraph break; keep Very off with Something was off rather than a new paragraph.
홀린 것처럼 is as if possessed; as if is the natural collocation and drops the extra he was.
이런 종류의 진상 is this kind of problem customer; contractions also read more like narration.
계속해서 곁눈질하던 그 순간 is ongoing glancing, then that moment; SOL reduces it to one glance.
야수처럼 번뜩 is a wild beast’s gleam, and now marks the hollow-to-sharp shift.
파란색? is confirming the truck already in view, so The blue one, not an indefinite A blue one.
Splitting the glance from the concession is cleaner rhythm without changing the action.
옆쪽으로 빠지겠습니다 is peel off to the side; SOL adds up ahead and loses the sideways move.
The 마치…것처럼 clause is its own beat; merging it into a trailing as if flattens that pause.
빼놓지 않았다 means he kept doing it; didn’t skip smelling is calqued.
Soaked with cold sweat is the English collocation; soaked in is no gain.
첫 개시부터 is his first fare; his makes the complaint attach to Kim.
아주 재수 옴 붙은 날이다 is about the day being jinxed, not that he is cursed.
부아앙 is stretched; Vrooom carries the extra length Vroom flattens.
The taxi shot off, so a monster chasing it; him shifts the object, and got in an accident is already idiomatic.
Entering the complex and hugging the box are separate source beats; merging swallows 소중히.
Keep 품에는 … 소중히 껴안은 채 as its own carefully hugged-box line.
Moved into an apartment is the natural English for 이사 보내다 here.
추락하는 is plunge/crash, stronger and closer than dropped.
집어치우자 is drop it/cut it out; put aside softens the self-rebuke.
늘 이렇다 is it was always like this, not this always happened.
다닥다닥 붙어 있는 is packed in tight, and 신호음이 울린 is the ringtone going on; SOL weakens both.
일어나야 is get up; wake up is a needless synonym.
Which one is the natural spoken way to forget building and unit.
가지가지 한다 is sibling you really are something else; damnedest things is dated.
질질 끌며 is dragging her slippers; along is filler.
날백수 포스 is bum energy; aura of an unemployed bum is stiff and over-explains 포스.
부녀회장 is the apartment women’s association president, not a generic residents’ association.
어린아이처럼 좋아하는 is a little kid delighted by a surprise gift.
풀썩 웃어 버렸다 is burst out laughing; a grin is a different face.
아침 준비 is making breakfast, but 기분 좋은 냄새 is a good/pleasant smell, not delicious.
decisions.replacement: Mom was busy making breakfast in the kitchen. A good smell hung in the air.

decisions.reason: 아주 신나셨네 is teasing; sure is excited captures that lilt better than is really.
The sofa sags after she sits; beneath her makes the pig joke land without adding a new action.
덕분에 잘 먹겠네 is we’ll eat well thanks to the feast, not Thanks to you, I’m eating well.
Eyes glued while answering is without taking her eyes off; one motion instead of but plus a second clause.
고생했다고 is everything I’ve been through, not merely all the work I did.
섭섭하다 is feeling a little hurt, and 하루 이틀은 아니지만 naturalizes as they’d always bickered.
죽을 고비 넘겨 is brushing past a death crisis; nearly dying flattens 고비 넘기다.
눈치 하나는 귀신이다 is punchy radar, not a gloss about terrifyingly sharp instincts.
급식충 is a school-lunch parasite, not a generic cafeteria jab.
개교기념일 is the school founding anniversary; dropping founding loses 개교.
그러면 진짜 지는 거다 is if I did, I’d really lose; the conditional is cleaner than doing it would mean I’d lost.
She yells 오빠 to Mom; Oppa matches her diction elsewhere in the chapter.
때리고, 꼬집고 is hitting and pinching him; the object is implied and English needs it.
고이 모셔 둔 is set so carefully; coincidence already covers 우연히, and chance is no gain.
활짝 열린 박스 is its own snapshot; deleting it collapses the two-beat reveal.
Keep the spill as the second image; SOL’s sprang open restates the deleted box line.
누르다 is pressed, but 깔렸다 fills the living-room space, not an invented silence.
decisions.replacement: Everything in the living room stopped as if someone had pressed pause. Only the quiet sound of stew simmering filled the space.

decisions.reason: 입을 열었다 is a hesitation beat before he speaks; SOL drops the action.
아무래도 … 것 같다 is it looked like / probably; It looked like tracks the hedge.
그렇게 된 거예요 is that’s how it happened, not merely what happened.
The wallet goes to Hayeon; naming her beats an ambiguous her after Mom’s line.
의구심 가득한 눈으로 바라보다가 is eyed me suspiciously; tighter than looked with suspicion, then.
손에 들린 카드 한 장 is a card in her hand; held up adds a lift the source doesn’t have.
말과는 달리 is despite what she said; more spoken than despite her words.
은색으로 반짝이는 자격증 is the license gleaming silver; gleam of nominalizes the image.
신음처럼 중얼거렸다 is muttered, almost a groan; as if groaning is stiffer.
이게 다 무슨 일이라니 is what on earth is all this, the money and license, not a generic happening.
탄내 나 is I smell something burning; I smell burning is clipped.
초토화 is a disaster zone, stronger and closer than a wreck; hurried to my feet covers 급한 대로.
따라온 is followed, not rushed; 발을 동동 굴렀다 is stamping, and in distress explains the gesture.
decisions.replacement: Mom followed me in, stamping her feet.

decisions.reason: 아이고, 이걸 어째! is an exclamation, not a question.
숯덩이가 된 is turned into lumps of charcoal; turned to lumps is off.
이런 전개 is a turn of events; this kind of development sounds like plot commentary.
외식이나 하러 가요 is let’s go out to eat, the usual US phrasing.
일장연설 is a lengthy speech, 부조리 is absurd prices, and 치킨 is fried chicken.
기다렸다는 듯이 is like she’d been waiting; as if is a synonym, not an upgrade in this voice.
Keeps the source ellipsis on 복장 규정이……; three periods is a convention change with no gain.
지불해야 한다 is cost per person; ran to … a person is awkward.
마찬가지거든요 is the other guests are the same; dressed accordingly spells out what the Korean leaves implied.
죄다 정장에 원피스 is the fragment all in suits and dresses; were wearing flattens 죄다.
그냥 나왔다 is just walked out; turned and and than I felt add motion and a feeling comparison the source doesn’t make.
우리 셋 includes him; SOL’s they/they owned drops the narrator, and 시장 메이커 is market-brand.
아껴 가며 is scrimping on his own food and clothes; cutting back is weaker.
남들보다 is everyone else, more natural than other people here.
고기집 is a barbecue/meat-grill place, not a generic meat place.
걱정 없이 사치 부려도 is they could splurge without worrying; afford to is extra.
The maxim is present-tense 살 수가 없다 / 가격표가 없다; past couldn’t/didn’t turns a saying into narration.
없어서 못 쓰는 게 돈이다 is a present-tense punch; was something you couldn’t spend dilutes it.
고민한 끝에 마침내 is thinking all night and finally deciding; wondering / in the end weakens both.
아낌없이 쓰기로 is spare no expense, closer than spend it freely.
지금 … 부풀렸다 is now that decision swelled; BASE’s past perfect is the wrong tense.
가장 크고 비싸다는 needs and between biggest and most expensive.
척하면 착이다 is cue-and-response; she always caught on fast loses that she got this cue.
피식 웃었다 is a snort-laugh, not a quiet laugh.
옷을 스캔하는 눈썰미 is a sharp eye for clothes; way she scanned is more literal.
적극적으로 움직이기 is shopping in earnest; moving with enthusiasm is vague.
신체의 변화를 느꼈다 is the clinical a change in my body joke; come over my body blurs that.
극심한 covers both breath and legs; SOL pads with suffering from, BASE underplays the leg pain.
decisions.replacement: Crushing shortness of breath and agonizing pain in my legs, for no reason I could name.

decisions.reason: 무력감이 온몸을 감싼다 is helplessness wrapping the body at Jopil’s level; washed over changes the image.
못생겼어. 저리 꺼져. is two snaps; Ugly. Get lost. matches that better than You’re ugly.
안 입어 봐도 and 그걸로 keep try it and that; SOL drops the trying and blurs which item.
The comma before or is optional; no real prose gain.
돌아갈 때쯤 is headed out/going back, not merely ready to leave, and All I know is, is the right register.
이렇게 예쁘게 is this pretty; so pretty is a synonym, not better.
소곤거리는 is whispered; spoke in hushed voices is heavier.
수십 배 is dozens of times the price, not times more, and 날이었다 should stay it was a day when.
decisions.replacement: We'd spent dozens of times the price of the several-hundred-thousand-won course meal just to eat it, but it was a day when not a single won felt wasted.

decisions.reason: 아깝지 않은 척했다 is pretended it wasn’t a waste; I pretended it didn’t is too truncated to land.
